name: The One Piece Is Real!
body:
# The One Piece Is Real!

Senpwai 3.0.0 is here! After three betas, the Flutter rebuild graduates to its first stable release on Android, Linux, macOS, and Windows. Thank you to everyone who tried it, reported bugs, and helped bring Senpwai back. 🥳

**Find your next anime:** Discover and search through AniList, filter results, and connect your account to browse your library.

**Download your way:** Choose AnimeHeaven, Nyaa, AnimePahe, or Tokyo Insider, with your preferred episode range, resolution, audio language, and folder. Scan for episodes you already have and review uncertain torrent matches before downloading.

**Keep up automatically:** Track ongoing anime with separate source, quality, language, folder, and filler preferences for each show. Episode badges make filler easier to spot.

**Pick up where you left off:** Your queue, paused downloads, and torrent seeding progress survive restarts. Interrupted transfers resume where supported; some sources require fresh links or a restart.

**Make it yours:** Customize themes, typography, cards, browsing details, and animations on phones, tablets, and desktops. ✨

**Better bug reports:** Copy diagnostics or send an error report to Discord from the app.

**Already on a v3 beta?** Update to stable through Senpwai's updater without uninstalling. Your settings, tracked anime, and download queue stay with you.

Windows installers remain unsigned and the macOS app is ad hoc signed, so your system may ask you to approve the first launch.

Believers rise up. Senpwai is back!

name: From You, 2000 Years Ago
body:
# From You, 2000 Years Ago

The third Senpwai 3 beta remembers your downloads, gives you more control over tracked anime, and lets you tune your browsing experience.

**Pick up where you left off:** Your download queue, paused items, and torrent seeding progress survive restarts. Transfers resume when safe recovery is supported, otherwise they restart with an explanation.

**Track it your way:** Set a source, resolution, audio language, and folder for each tracked anime. Source choices are checked before being locked in, and tracking controls fit better on mobile.

**Make browsing yours:** Hide ratings or synopses, toggle genres and native titles, use compact cards, pause banner rotation, and reduce animations. ✨

**Your preferences matter:** Choose whether downloads can fall back to another audio language or resolution when your selection is unavailable.

**Before you go:** Choose whether Senpwai asks before quitting while downloads or seeding are active.

**Torrent networking:** Fixed proxy settings and added an option to bind torrent traffic to a chosen VPN interface.

**Source fixes:** Corrected AnimePahe sequel numbering, improved AnimeHeaven file checks and connection retries, and tightened Nyaa title matching. AnimeHeaven now skips raw episodes without breaking the episode list.

**Better bug reports:** Improved saved logs and copied error reports to make troubleshooting easier.

**For the early birds:** Nightly builds now have their own release channel, with clearer beta and nightly choices on the download page.

Download recovery applies to downloads created after installing this update. Some interrupted downloads may need fresh source access or a restart.

This is still a beta, so expect and report bugs. Windows installers are unsigned and the macOS app is ad hoc signed; your system may ask you to approve the first launch.

name: Made In Heaven
body:
# Made In Heaven

The second Senpwai 3 beta brings a new Cloudflare-free source and handles
browser trouble better.

- **New source, AnimeHeaven:** Direct downloads, no Cloudflare, no browser
  window. 😇
- **New defaults:** AnimeHeaven and Nyaa are on by default. AnimePahe and Tokyo
  Insider can be enabled in **Settings → Sources & Search**. Coming from beta 1?
  Enable AnimeHeaven there.
- **Faster planning:** AnimeHeaven links are fetched in parallel, tunable under
  **Request Parallelism**.
- **Browser trouble, handled:** If the built-in browser can't open, Senpwai
  offers to disable the sources that need it.
- **Fewer connection errors:** Fixed connections to HTTP/1.1-only servers.

This is still a beta, so expect and report bugs. Windows installers are unsigned
and the macOS app is ad-hoc signed; your system may ask you to approve the first
launch.

name: Chat we are so back!
body:
# Chat we are so back!

It's been a long quiet stretch, but Senpwai is back with its biggest overhaul
yet. The app is rebuilt in Flutter, is now available on Android, Linux, macOS,
Windows, and packed in a lot more than a fresh coat of paint. This is the first
beta of Senpwai 3! 🥳

- **Find your next anime:** Discover and search through AniList, filter the
  results, and connect your account to browse your library.
- **Pick how you download:** Grab episodes from Animepahe, Tokyo Insider, or
  Nyaa. Choose your episode range, resolution, audio
  preference, source, and download folder.
- **Let Senpwai do the tedious bits:** Scan folders to skip episodes you already
  have, optionally skip filler, and review Nyaa matches before a torrent batch
  starts.
- **Stay in control:** Pause, resume, and reorder downloads while watching
  progress, speed, and torrent activity in one queue.
- **Never miss the next episode:** Track ongoing anime and let Senpwai check for
  new episodes using the download choices you saved for each show.
- **Make it yours:** Switch themes, typography, and card layouts in an interface
  built for phones, tablets, and desktops. ✨

This is a beta, so expect and report bugs. Windows
installers are unsigned and the macOS app is ad-hoc signed; your system may ask
you to approve the first launch.

Believers rise up, the doubters are in shambles!
